Tuning parameters for count regression models

Source: R/parsnip-count_reg.R
count_family.Rd

dials parameters for count_reg: the count distribution (the main argument family) and engine arguments. Arguments of count_reg() marked with tune() use them automatically.

Usage

count_family(
  values = c("POISSON", "NB1", "NB2", "NBP", "GP1", "GP2", "PIG1", "PIG2", "PL", "PLN",
    "COM")
)

count_components(range = c(2L, 4L), trans = NULL)

count_zero_type(values = c("inflated", "hurdle"))

count_correlated(values = c(FALSE, TRUE))

count_re_dist(values = c("normal", "uniform", "triangular", "gamma"))

Arguments

values

the candidate values.

range

the smallest and largest number of components or classes.

trans

a transformation (see dials::new_quant_param()).

Value

A dials parameter.

Details

ParameterArgumentEngine
count_family()familyall with a family
count_components()components, classes"countreg_mix", "countreg_lc"
count_zero_type()zero_type"flexCountReg"
count_correlated()correlated"countreg_rp", "countreg_mix", "countreg_lc"
count_re_dist()re_dist"countreg_hier" (one term)

The families supported by "countreg_fe" ("POISSON" and "NB2" by default here) and "negmultinom" ("NM1", "NM2" and "NMP") are their own default values. Any other engine argument can be tuned with an explicit grid, or with update() on the parameter set.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("dials", quietly = TRUE)) {
  count_family()
  count_components()
}
#> # Mixture Components (quantitative)
#> Range: [2, 4]
